title: Polyoxometalate-based all-inorganic open frameworks
claim: Formation of suitable POM cluster building units, and therefore of the corresponding all-inorganic frameworks, is generally confined to a narrow pH window and is also sensitive to temperature and cation concentration.
explanation: The synthesis section states that most known frameworks form only in a narrow pH range because the POM SBUs themselves are pH-sensitive, while reaction temperature, cooling rate, and ambient temperature affect crystal growth. A concrete control experiment keeps pH fixed and varies temperature and Ag+ concentration to obtain different {P8W48} architectures, including a less dense cubic phase when pH is adjusted.
scope: Solution and hydrothermal synthesis of POM-based all-inorganic open frameworks, documented in detail for {P8W48}/Ag systems.
conditions: For the Ag/{P8W48} series, higher Ag+ with heating to 80 °C versus lower Ag+ without heating, and a further pH change under the latter conditions, select among W11a–W11c.
caveats: The review does not give one universal pH interval; the narrow window is a qualitative generalization across reported compounds.
